label: Character references
description: Reference sheets of a person or a creature, each its own image: a turnaround and the face, close. Make an Element of them.

inputs.label: Photos
inputs.phrase: The character is the person in {}: same face, hair, body and features.

inputs.label: Match sheet
inputs.phrase: Keep everything exactly as in {}, a sheet of the same set: the same face, hair, body, outfit and colors.

fields.label: Who
fields.placeholder: a woman in her 30s, short red hair, green parka

options.value: the same character four times side by side, full body from head to toe, front view, three-quarter view, side profile and back view, a neutral standing pose with the arms slightly away from the body, evenly spaced at the same scale

options.value: a close-up of the character's head and shoulders facing the camera, a neutral expression, sharp detail of the face, eyes, skin and hair
options.label: Face close-up

options.value: the character's face six times in a 3 by 2 grid: neutral, happy, sad, angry, surprised and thinking
options.label: Expressions
